name: Gdynia

queries.query: Gdynia official cadastral parcel map GIS land register Poland Geoportal
queries.result: Official Gdynia WebEWID map documentation and Poland's official Geoportal EGiB download service were found. The bounded WFS request returned three parcel polygons near the preserved WUP point.

queries.query: Gdynia oficjalna mapa działek ewidencja gruntów geoportal miejski
queries.result: Polish-language discovery identified the official Gdynia WebEWID portal documentation and the GUGiK EGiB WFS service. The service response exposed parcel geometry and stable ID_DZIALKI values without requesting owner or other unsafe fields.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Gdynia's official WebEWID map portal documentation describes public map search for parcels (działki), buildings and addresses; the documented portal is hosted on the official city domain.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK) publishes the official aggregate EGiB WFS, built from county EGiB services and covering Poland to the extent supplied by those services.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Local official map procedure plus a successful official EGiB parcel-vector response for Gdynia; registryFound=true reflects evidenced public cadastral/map access, not owner or title access.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: A historical Gdynia map URL cited by an official municipal PDF returned 404; no absence inference was made.

Official Gdynia WebEWID documentation loaded and states that the map viewer supports searching parcels, buildings and addresses and viewing map objects. It is documentation, not the parcel-vector endpoint itself.
Official GUGiK aggregate WFS capabilities returned ms:dzialki with default CRS EPSG:2180 and supported EPSG:4326; safe parcel and geometry schema was identified.
Schema exposed geom and ID_DZIALKI plus other source fields. Only geom and ID_DZIALKI were requested; unsafe fields were not requested or retained.

Returned three unchanged GML parcel polygons near the exact WUP point. EPSG:4326 response coordinates were converted to GeoJSON axis order [longitude, latitude]; native IDs were 226201_1.0026.704, 226201_1.0026.718 and 226201_1.0026.719.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Gdynia WebEWID documentation was inspected; its live application configuration was not needed because the official GUGiK EGiB WFS was independently qualified.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 in the retained sample; service default is EPSG:2180 and EPSG:4326 is an advertised alternate CRS.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The returned ID_DZIALKI values encode the Gdynia cadastral unit and precinct/parcel path (for example 226201_1.0026.704); the complete native value is retained as the canonical id.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: BBox around exact WUP point [54.5322041862711, 18.5076341710355], preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift was used.

safeFieldAllowlist: public source layer and service metadata

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The request bbox contained the exact point; this is bounded sample evidence only and not a citywide coverage claim.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: GUGiK aggregate EGiB WFS says it aggregates county EGiB services across Poland to the extent those services provide data.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three Gdynia parcel polygons were verified in one bounded anonymous response; local citywide completeness and update cadence were not independently measured.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
scopeLimits: This is cadastral-source research, not source integration or runtime admission.
The exact WUP point and population values were preserved; no coordinate was moved to force a parcel hit.
Three polygons are a bounded sample and do not prove citywide parcel coverage, completeness, or freshness.
Only safe IDs and geometry were retained; source-specific raw attributes remain in ignored temporary evidence only.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: The official GUGiK aggregate WFS and Gdynia WebEWID documentation provide credible public cadastral access, and the sample geometry/IDs are verified. The live Gdynia application endpoint, county-level completeness, and production adapter suitability remain for independent serial review.
